samples.question: This picture is a floor plan drawn in two colours: white is open corridor and black is solid wall. You may move only through white corridor and never through black wall. The corridors form a plan with no loop, so between any two points of white corridor there is exactly one route that never doubles back. There is one green dot, one blue dot and one red dot, each in its own part of the corridor. Measure distance only as the length of corridor you walk along that route, following every turn; straight-line distance across the picture does not count. Walking from the green dot, which dot is farther away, the blue dot or the red dot? Answer blue or red.
